content: McSupportData . measurableSystemConstantValues In addition to variables and parameters, also names and values of system constants may need to be transferred to an MCD tool in order to be displayed. These are mod- eled by the role McSupportData . measurableSystemConstantValues . Note that the values of system constants are also possibly subject to compile-time variation (not visible in the figure).
